bear.point: PAT fell 36.2% YoY despite 11.9% revenue growth, indicating severe bottom-line erosion.
EBITDA margin dropped 9.9 pp YoY to 24.6%, showing significant operating leverage loss.
US sales declined 8.2% to USD455 million, driven by Ilumya growth slowdown.
R&D spend at 4.8% of sales misses the promised 6-7% range.

bull.point: Sales grew 11.8% YoY to INR1,61,000 million, exceeding high single-digit targets.
Gross margin reached 80.8%, higher than last year due to better product mix.
India formulations sales grew 17.3% to INR55,523 million, outpacing overall company growth.
Operating cash flow was 1.20x PAT over FY22-FY26, ensuring strong cash conversion.
